Decision: Create exactly two primary experimental ML conditions: 298 K and 77 K.
Scientific_Rationale: Same homogenized material is tensile-tested at two directly reported temperatures.
Implementation_Rule: P015_MC_298K and P015_MC_77K are independent condition-level rows; replicate_n=3 remains metadata only.

Decision: 298 K effective target = TRIP 0 / TWIP 1 / Slip 1.
Scientific_Rationale: Initial single FCC remains single FCC after fracture by both XRD and EBSD; deformation twins are directly confirmed.
Implementation_Rule: This is an explicit condition-wide negative TRIP label, not NA.

Decision: 77 K effective target = TRIP 1 / TWIP 1 / Slip 1.
Scientific_Rationale: Initial single FCC transforms partly to ε-HCP and direct deformation twins/secondary twins form at cryogenic temperature.
Implementation_Rule: Use experimental XRD/EBSD/TEM as target evidence.

Decision: Use 1e-3 s^-1 as canonical experimental strain rate; log the 1000 s^-1 figure-caption conflict.
Scientific_Rationale: Methods and body text agree on 1e-3 s^-1; several captions conflict.
Implementation_Rule: Do not create a 1000 s^-1 experimental condition from P015.

Decision: SFE = 36.62 mJ/m2 at 298 K and 10.97 mJ/m2 at 77 K, both MD-calculated.
Scientific_Rationale: Current paper explicitly reports temperature-dependent MD SFE values.

Decision: Keep analytical critical stresses separate from experimental mechanism labels.
Scientific_Rationale: Thresholds are model-derived and 298 K agreement is explicitly poor.
Implementation_Rule: Use as physics/model descriptors with reliability scope, not target truth.

Decision: Do not promote the eight MD strain snapshots to experimental ML samples.
Scientific_Rationale: They are correlated computational trajectory observations under a distinct simulation domain.

Decision: Do not invent measured bulk composition.
Scientific_Rationale: Only nominal Fe50Mn20Cr20Ni10 is supplied; 5 wt% extra Mn is a melting-charge compensation detail.
Implementation_Rule: Measured_Composition remains NA; preserve nominal chemistry and charge adjustment separately.

Decision: Preserve engineering and true mechanical properties separately.
Scientific_Rationale: Paper reports engineering YS/UTS/elongation and Table 1 true stress quantities/HC.
Implementation_Rule: Never overwrite engineering YS/UTS with true values.
